quick.summary: Why they ignore your dashboard, and how to fix it by sharing a rough sketch.
quick.takeaway: Ask what they want before you build. Let them shape the early draft.

beats.line: I spent two weeks on the sales report. Why did they ignore it?
Imagine baking a huge cake, only to learn they wanted pie.
I did not ask what they were hungry for.
Exactly. You built it alone. Bring them into the kitchen first.
Show a rough sketch. Ask if it solves their problem.
People call this getting stakeholder buy in.
Can I just say, making sure they want it?
Yes. Let them shape the early draft.
So I draw the chart on paper and ask the sales lead first?
Yes. Now you are cooking together.

quiz.question: You are starting a big sales dashboard. What should you do first?
options: Ask the sales team what they need.
Guess what they want to see.
quiz.explanation: Bring them into the kitchen early. Ask what they need before you build.

quiz.question: Showing an early, rough sketch to a stakeholder is a bad idea.
quiz.explanation: A rough sketch lets them shape the work early, preventing surprises later.
